issues.reason: A non-modal verbal generic over a kind "becomes a rule that gives each instance its own event, via a Skolem-function event term", and the indefinite-singular object does bar the kind-relation route, so the flat bundle is the wrong shape — and it existentially asserts a particular coat, a particular keeper and a particular staining that a generic never posits.

The generic machinery puts the kind in the rule's premise range, and the one bare-class-symbol slot the set licenses is a non-specific / generic object ("pays tax", "grows wheat"), so (Agent sk_stain_1 mire_essence) seats a kind — the very symbol carrying the kind-level genus (Inheritance mire_essence essence) — in an individual role position.

gaps_confirmed: gradual-process / open-frame adverbial "over time" (and "gradually") has no licensed carrier: Duration takes a vague-extent surface adverb, (Measure e duration n u) needs a stated figure and unit, and WithinLast is a backward-looking window
defect_summary: Compliant form is the distributing rule (Implication (Member $x mire_essence) (And (Member (sk_stain $x) stain) (Agent (sk_stain $x) $x) (Patient (sk_stain $x) (sk_coat $x)) (Member (sk_coat $x) coat) (Possession (sk_coat $x) (sk_keeper $x)) (Member (sk_keeper $x) keeper))) at (STV 0.9 0.9), the dependent coat and keeper as per-binding Skolem functions, with only the definitional (Inheritance mire_essence essence) left at top level; the kind symbol then appears as the premise range and never as an Agent filler.
notes: Leaving "over time" out rather than mis-slotting it is exactly what the instruction set prescribes for an unrepresentable adverbial. The Possession head for "a Keeper's coat", the Patient role for a substance-applying verb, and the unexposed noun modifier in mire_essence are all correct.
